brief:
Hamas warned of escalating war crimes by the Israeli government and military, Shehab Wire reported. The movement issued the caution after Israel announced a broad military operation in Shuafat refugee camp and the town of Anata, located northeast of occupied Jerusalem.

Hamas cautioned against the consequences of the declared operation without specifying what actions or response the group might take in response to the Israeli military move.
